observation_window.query_content_snapshot_semantics: GitHub search-index contents observed during the two frozen acquisitions; no historical body reconstruction is claimed

population_scope.unit: one eligible public maintenance record from one immutable GitHub repository lineage
population_scope.target_population: public GitHub issues and merged pull requests in the frozen observation window that match at least one atomic query and pass the separately frozen V2 eligibility protocol
population_scope.claim_boundary: The frame estimates the declared query-defined post-treatment population only; it does not represent all GitHub repositories, all maintenance work, or community-wide Skill superiority.
population_scope.query_overlap_policy: union by immutable GitHub record node ID before eligibility review
population_scope.record_choice_policy: freeze every matching record first; choose at most one eligible record per repository lineage only after external randomness is available

pagination.page_retry_identity_rule: a retry must preserve the query atom, shard, API version, and page; divergent item identities fail the acquisition

completeness.terminal_shard_check: unique returned node IDs equal total_count and every advertised page is present
completeness.union_check: deduplicate by node_id while retaining every query-atom and shard membership
completeness.repeat_acquisition: two complete acquisitions after the observation window must produce identical node-ID sets for every terminal shard
completeness.content_drift_policy: any title, body, labels, state reason, repository identity, or timestamp drift between acquisitions blocks the frame

per_request: ETag when supplied by GitHub or explicit null

prohibitions: No GitHub search result is an eligibility decision.
No term hit establishes a stratum without blinded review.
No result outside the frozen atomic-query union may be added.
No task, private label, model call, treatment output, preview, approval, or paid execution may exist before the population and selection receipts are frozen.
No credential value, private repository, GitHub Archive, BigQuery mirror, or third-party GitHub dataset enters the population.
